# Ficus & Salt

> Wood-fired Mediterranean small-plates restaurant and natural wine bar in the Northbridge harbor district. Demo/placeholder business used as a reference implementation of a restaurant landing-page template — see README.md.

## Concept
Mediterranean small plates cooked over an open wood fire, paired with a natural wine list. Shared-plate format, unhurried pace, small dining room.

## Cuisine
Mediterranean, small plates, wine bar. Price range: $$.

## Signature dishes
- Wood-Fired Octopus
- Whipped Feta & Hot Honey
- Lamb Kofta Skewers
- Charred Eggplant Dip
- Saffron Mussels
- Olive Oil Cake

## Location
214 Harbor Row, Northbridge. Map: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=214+Harbor+Row+Northbridge

## Hours
Tue–Thu 5:00pm–10:00pm, Fri–Sat 5:00pm–11:00pm, Sun 5:00pm–9:00pm, closed Monday.
